name: Dhurandhar AI Security
author: midhunesh

sections.description:
Developed by Arnav Ajith & Midhunesh M

Dhurandhar AI Security is an advanced security plugin that uses AI-based analysis to detect potential vulnerabilities, malicious code, and security threats in your WordPress site.

Features:
– AI-based threat detection
– Malware analysis
– Security monitoring
– Lightweight and fast

External services

This plugin connects to OpenAI API for AI-based threat analysis.

What data is sent:
– PHP code snippets selected by the user

When:
– Only when the user initiates a scan

Why:
– To analyze potential security threats

Service provider:
https://openai.com/

Terms:
https://openai.com/terms/

Privacy:
https://openai.com/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/dhurandhar-ai-security directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → AI Security to configure.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin send data externally?

Yes, only when AI scan is triggered.

Is it safe?

Yes, data is only sent securely to OpenAI API.
